summary: Embed risk-based security into software delivery with NIST SSDF, OWASP ASVS and practical implementation exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: DevSecOps implementation embeds risk-based security controls into software delivery workflows in regulated environments. It is for application security and software engineering leads, platform teams, and delivery managers who need to connect security findings with owners, remediation, and release decisions. Learners assess delivery maturity, model service threats, set risk-tiered verification gates, triage component vulnerabilities, and create accountable release records and an implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, secure or approve software delivery in regulated environments and need workable controls within existing engineering workflows.
